# Lab 21.2: Create a Reservation with Autoscaling

## What We Are Going to Do
Create a Standard edition reservation with zero baseline and autoscaling, run a query on it, and delete it. You pay only while slots scale up.

## Steps

1. **[Console] Create the reservation.** **Administration → Workload management → Create reservation**:
   - **Name**: `lab-std`, **Location**: US, **Edition**: Standard
   - **Baseline slots**: 0, **Max slots**: 100

2. **[CLI] Assign the project.**

CODE • BASH

<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq mk --reservation_assignment --reservation_id=$PROJECT_ID:US.lab-std \
  --job_type=QUERY --assignee_type=PROJECT --assignee_id=$PROJECT_ID
bq ls --reservation --location=US
bq ls --reservation_assignment --location=US</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   The same reservation from the CLI: `bq mk --reservation --location=US --edition=STANDARD --slots=0 --autoscale_max_slots=100 lab-std`.

3. **[SQL] Run a query and check where it ran.**

</code></pre>
</div>


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT job_id, reservation_id, total_slot_ms, total_bytes_billed
FROM `region-us`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.JOBS_BY_USER
ORDER BY creation_time DESC LIMIT 1;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   `reservation_id` shows `lab-std`, and the job is billed by slots, not bytes.

4. **[Console] Watch autoscaling.** In **Monitoring**, the reservation's slot chart shows the autoscaler going up and back to 0. Billing is per second with fluid scaling.

5. **[CLI] Delete everything.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq rm --reservation_assignment $(bq ls --reservation_assignment --location=US --format=json | python3 -c "import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)[0]['name'])")
bq rm --reservation --location=US lab-std</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Baseline 0 | Nothing billed when idle |
| Autoscaling | Up to 100 slots when busy |
| Billing | Slot-seconds used |
| Proof | `reservation_id` on the job |
